XMLDB.COMMENT: ViMi Pad question type - per-question options.

TABLE.NAME: qtype_vimipad_options
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-question configuration for ViMi Pad questions.

FIELD.NAME: profile
FIELD.COMMENT: The mod_vimipad diagram profile key this question is constrained to.

FIELD.NAME: allowedshapes
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional comma-separated list of allowed node shapes; empty means the profile default.

FIELD.NAME: referencemap
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional author reference map (serialised JSON) used for automatic grading.

FIELD.NAME: minnodes
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum node count for structural grading when no reference map is set.

FIELD.NAME: minrelations
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum relation count for structural grading when no reference map is set.
